patches_added.name: Google Clock MediaBrowser upstream compatibility
patches_added.description: Isolated port of the upstream YT Music MediaBrowser unlock: bypasses the caller certificate gate and restores the original com.google.android.apps.youtube.music identity inside search_media_items.

patches_added.name: Library Mode Focus Fix
patches_added.description: Returns Library focus to the previously selected Saved or Cloud mode.

patches_added.name: Local Media
patches_added.description: Adds Library > Storage playback, folder selection, and same-basename sidecar subtitles for local video files.

patches_removed.name: Binge Group Manual Fallback
patches_removed.description: Adds Morphe > Playback control to open the source picker when no preferred binge-group stream is found.

patches_modified.name: Allow Importing Subs from Local Storage
patches_modified.description: Imports device subtitle files into Nuvio's ExoPlayer subtitle menu without rebuilding active playback.

patches_modified.name: Mark SDH Subtitles
patches_modified.description: Marks explicitly labelled SDH tracks and detected English SDH subtitle files.

patches_modified.name: Random Episode
patches_modified.description: Adds Morphe > Detail Page > Show Random Episode Button and random series playback.

patches_modified.name: Rating Visibility
patches_modified.description: Adds Settings > Morphe > Ratings with independent overall and episode rating controls.

patches_modified.name: Remove SDH Annotations
patches_modified.description: Adds Settings → Morphe → Subtitles and removes SDH annotations from Media3 subtitles when enabled.

patches_added.name: Disable Notification Defaults
patches_added.description: Turns off the Toolbar, Recommended contents, and Tool notifications channels by default.

patches_added.name: Hide Settings Items
patches_added.description: Hides the Download tools and Phone clean categories, and their sub-items, from Settings.
